items.prompt: VX 70, VA 104 at 2,000 lb and crosswind 17 are from the FPI checkout sheet, not the 1975 manual.
Do not slam the baggage door.
Club: add 1 qt at 9. Keep 2 qt in the baggage area.
Cold start: no prime, 1 or 2 pumps, throttle ¼ in. If it will not start, prime 2 or 3 strokes and lock the primer IN.
Overprimed or flooded: see Flooded Engine Clearing.
STEP left, AUTO right. It only knows what you tell it: check the tanks visually.
REM wrong: hold STEP and AUTO together 5 seconds, then re-enter fuel.
Tap STEP silences an alarm for 10 minutes. Hold STEP until OFF to silence it for the flight.
Hold LF about 5 seconds until Normalize shows.
Lean as required. Keep hottest CHT below 380°F.
Full rich. Lean below 65% power (club). Watch CHT; lower the nose to 90 or more if it rises.
Lean only below 65% power (club). Peak EGT at 55% or less. No lean of peak.
STEP left, LF right. Peak only at 55% power or less (club: below 65%).
Enrichen from peak: best power 125°F, extended range 75°F, best economy at peak (55% or less). Rough before peak: use onset of roughness.
ICE ZONE light or a manifold pressure drop means carb ice. RPM stays constant.
Use the minimum heat that prevents ice and lean slightly for smoothness.
Low pressure with normal temperature may be the gauge or relief valve. Land to inspect.
Red lines on the EDM and gauge (about 450 to 460°F CHT) are too high to use. Club limit: hottest CHT below 380°F, redline 400°F.
Never silence CHT or OIL blind. Avoid pressing both buttons (programming) in flight. Report repeat alarms.
OVER VOLTAGE light (HIGH VOLTAGE in the manual): the sensor trips the alternator at about 16 V.
S-TEC System 40/50, no REV button. Panel AP toggle at far left. Yoke disconnect to be confirmed.
AUX INST AIR: panel toggle below and left of the pilot's yoke panel entry.
Treat attitude and heading indicators as unreliable until suction is normal.
Signs: continuous discharge or LOW VOLTAGE light.
EMERG AVIONICS (console, guard cover) powers the main bus about 30 minutes. Leave the main battery switch ON.
Ice raises stall speed. Flaps can reduce elevator effectiveness with tail ice.
Fire out and power needed: master ON, find the tripped breaker (do not reset), add equipment one at a time.
